posts.author: patrickdevivo
posts.text_excerpt:
on @PowersetRes we run an LLM embedding pipeline to  categorize repos based on their READMEs and website content.

we use embedding similarity to a category centroid to determine membership- it works, but seems like a place Jev could really shine

could simplify a whole lot and probably be faster/cheaper

Built an alternative version of @typesafeai but on @cerebras with Qwen 3.8 27b.

Similar quality, similar performance, but vastly different cost. TypeSafe was way cheaper, and did beat Qwen on performance.

Closest we can get using LLMs I think.

Source: https://github.com/iammrduncan/typesafe-ai-benchmark
